content: macOS menu bar/Dock app name comes from Info.plist CFBundleName/CFBundleDisplayName inside the .app bundle, not Qt code. PyInstaller BUNDLE() controls this via a custom Info.plist. Cmd+Q and standard app-menu are provided by Qt/Cocoa automatically for a properly bundled .app, but do not work correctly for a bare script/onefile binary run outside a .app bundle.
